text:
Iris: pasted a new compact mock for p95 + minimap that leans into tactile affordances (bigger handles, tactile shadows) and stronger contrast tokens. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/tactile/p95-minimap (image) Dan: looks promising. two quick flags: 1) tactile shadows could clash with stacked charts visually, 2) larger handles risk occluding data in very tight UIs. can we test a 12px visual handle with a 20px invisible hit area? :mag_right: Keisha: yes to invisible hit area. also propose a mode switch: "Tactile mode" that enlarges hit targets and adds subtle shadows for users who prefer touch interactions. default stays compact. Omar: implementation note: invisible hit area is easy if we use a single canvas layer with pointer-event regions. would avoid extra DOM. also we should throttle pointermove to 60fps and cancel animations on new input. Jess: accessibility nits: 1) ensure focus styling doesn't rely only on shadow; provide a high-contrast outline for keyboard and high-contrast themes, 2) handles need role="slider" and aria-roledescription="time range handle" with aria-valuetext like "start 10:00, end 12:00" when moved. Vik: copy suggestion for the micro-summary: current: "Window 10m00m (p95 290ms)" proposed: "Viewing 1000m 195: 290ms" keeps p95 early which helps scanning. Also keep units (ms) explicit. Iris: good call. also thinking of changing the toggle copy under minimap: from "Apply to dashboard" to "Sync selection" (verb-first). shorter and consistent with other places that use "Sync". Dan: UX debate: should Sync be destructive? i.e., change global timepicker immediately, or show a preview with an explicit "Sync" button? I'm leaning preview-by-default. Keisha: preview-by-default is safer. micro-flow: drag selection -> preview applied to chart only -> small inline control appears: [Sync selection] [Pin] with secondary "Cancel preview" tiny link. Jess: SR flow: when preview activates announce "Previewing range 10 to 20 minutes. Press Enter to pin, press Esc to cancel." use aria-live polite for previews and assertive for pin confirmations. Omar: event contract suggestion: `minimap:preview({start,end, samplingMode})` and `minimap:sync({start,end, pinned})`. samplingMode helps the chart choose resolution during preview. Vik: sampling microcopy: instead of "Auto" use "Balanced (cost-aware)". offers clearer value prop. we should show the current sampling rate inline like "Balanced — 1s". Iris: accessibility copy tweak for tooltips: reduce punctuation noise for SRs. current: "p95: 290ms @ 11:20" -> propose "p95 290 milliseconds at 11:20" for SR-specific strings (keep compact visuals for sighted UI). Dan: mobile nuance: tactile shadows + large handles feel good but eat vertical space. propose "Tactile mode" only on small screens when user enables it in preferences or on first-use prompt. default remains compact. Keisha: keyboard shortcuts proposal: `[` and `]` to move window left/right 5%, `Shift+[` and `Shift+]` to expand/shrink by 10%, `P` to pin/sync, `V` to toggle tactile mode. document in help center. Jess: code snippet for aria attributes I tested: ```
``` Make sure aria-valuetext includes units and full words for screen readers. Omar: perf note: rendering rug ticks at high density is costly. consider an LOD approach: render sparse ticks at <240px, denser above. and precompose 95+ highlights into the sprite sheet to avoid repeated drawing. Vik: copy for toast when pinning: current: "Pinned range" -> proposed: "Selection pinned — view updated". clearer for less experienced users. SR assertive: "Selection pinned from 10 to 20 minutes". Iris: decision list: 1) implement invisible 20px hit areas with 12px visual handle, 2) add "Tactile mode" opt-in (pref + first-run), 3) preview-by-default flow with inline [Sync selection] CTA, 4) sampling copy = "Balanced (cost-aware) — 1s", 5) stronger focus outline for A11y + aria-valuetext strings for SRs, 6) LOD ticks and precomposed 95 highlights for perf, 7) updated toast copy. I'll push updated Figma and a11y doc by EOD tomorrow. Dan: tagging @Omar and @Jess for implementation/a11y sync when mocks are live. thanks team! :rocket:
